Complete Hajj and 'umrah for Allah, with sacrifice or fasting where due, no sexual relations or disputing in Hajj, departing from 'Arafat, and remembering Allah during the numbered days.
The first House of worship for mankind is at Makkah, with the standing place of Abraham; whoever enters is safe, and pilgrimage to it is due from those able.
Believers must not violate Allah's rites, the sacred month, the sacrificial animals or those coming to the Sacred House, nor let hatred drive them to transgress, but cooperate in righteousness.
Abraham is given the site of the House to purify it and proclaim the Hajj; pilgrims come, mention Allah over sacrificial animals, feed the poor and circle the House.
